title: Private deployments runway cost allocation sandbox
summary: Working spreadsheet that allocates runway and headcount costs across private deployment bundles (on-prem, VPC, hybrid). Focus is on short-term cash runway impact, 3/5-year annualized TCO, and bundle-level per-unit pricing guidance for licensing + support mix. This is a sandbox used to generate recommendations for packaging and sales talking points.
assumptions: Currency = USD; discount rate/weighted cost of capital = 8% nominal; hardware refresh every 3 years on on-prem baseline, 4 years in hybrid; utilization expressed as average steady-state outbound capacity (QPS equivalent) and % GPU utilization. Support tiers: Bronze (24x5 email), Silver (24x7 email + 8x5 phone), Gold (SLA, 4-hour on-call). Licensing models considered: per-host (onprem license), per-GPU bundle, capacity-commit (vCPU/GPU hour), and unit-based (TU: tokens served per month).
calc_notes: Key formulas described for review: Total Year1 = CapEx + OpEx Year1 + Licensing Year1 + Support Year1 + Onboarding/Setup. Annualized N-year = (CapEx / N) + OpEx annual + Licensing annual + Support annual. Per-inference unit cost = Annualized Total / (Projected tokens/year). Sensitivity levers: utilization +/- 20%, refresh interval +/- 1 year, support mix +/- 15% of customers move up a tier. Depreciation schedule, tax, and lease-vs-buy treated via CapEx amortization and optional lease lines.
scenario_notes: Observations from first-pass models: 1) For high steady-state throughput (>= 500M tokens/year) on-prem mid/large becomes materially cheaper per-token over 3-5yr amortization, even after conservative support & ops. 2) VPC-managed has predictable OpEx but very high per-token cost at lower volumes; attractive when time-to-market and headcount constraints matter. 3) Hybrid provides good middle ground for customers with spiky loads: reserve baseline on-prem/hybrid and burst to VPC; effective only if network egress & orchestration costs are tightly constrained. 4) Support bundle mix moves margin faster than hardware refresh assumptions — a 10% shift from Silver->Gold increases Year1 cost by ~3-6% depending on scenario. 5) Onboarding/Ops ramp (1.0-1.5x in Year1) is non-linear and should be charged as a separate professional-services line for 75% of customers.

recommendations: Short list recommendations for product + GTM: 1) Create two recommended bundles for Sales: 'Core Private' (on-prem reserved hardware + Silver support + 1yr licensing) and 'Private Enterprise' (24/7 Gold + proactive SRE add-on + 3-year bundle discount). 2) Price a separable onboarding PS line at 12-18% of Year1 TCV for on-prem deployments to avoid margin erosion. 3) Offer hybrid burst credits (pre-bought VPC reserved credits) at a 20% premium over baseline VPC cost but with predictable capacity SLAs. 4) For deals projecting >= 500M tokens/year, present 3/5-year amortized per-token comparison side-by-side to justify on-prem commitment. 5) Build a quick calculator for Sales that flips lever inputs: utilization, refresh, support mix, token forecasts and outputs 3yr/5yr per-1k-token costs and recommended bundle.
